title: A 24-year study uncovers a surprising climate benefit beneath forests
caption:
A 24-year monitoring program across German woodlands reveals that drying ground can accelerate atmospheric methane breakdown. Microbes underground consume more gas when dry pores let it sink deeper into the dirt.

Source: Sciencedaily - A 24-year study uncovers a surprising climate benefit beneath forests

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261014015525.htm
